title: Take Five Slow Breaths
description: Take five slow breaths and focus only on your breathing.

title: Breathe in a Box
description: Breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, rest for 4. Repeat four times.

title: Try the 4-7-8 Breath
description: Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, exhale slowly for 8. Repeat four times.

title: Breathe with Your Belly
description: Place a hand on your belly and breathe so your hand rises and falls slowly.

title: Exhale Twice as Long
description: For two minutes, make each exhale twice as long as your inhale.

title: Listen to Your Breath
description: Close your eyes and listen to the sound of your own breathing for one minute.

title: Hum to Soothe
description: Exhale while humming softly. Feel the vibration calm your chest.

title: Count Ten Slow Breaths
description: Count ten breaths, slow and even, without rushing any of them.

title: Name Five Things You See
description: Look around and name five things you can see right now.

title: Feel Three Things
description: Notice three physical sensations: the chair, the floor, the air on your skin.

title: Use the 5-4-3-2-1 Senses
description: Name 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, 1 you taste.

title: Plant Your Feet
description: Stand or sit, press both feet into the ground, and notice the pressure for a minute.

title: Touch Something Textured
description: Find a textured object and run your fingers over it slowly, paying full attention.

title: Take a Cold Sip
description: Drink a glass of cold water slowly, noticing the temperature.

title: Say the Date Out Loud
description: Say today's date, the day, and one true fact about this moment out loud.

title: Name Three Sounds Around You
description: Stop and name three sounds you can hear right now.

title: Scan Your Body Quickly
description: From head to toe, notice where you hold tension for 20 seconds each spot.

title: Tense and Release Your Shoulders
description: Shrug your shoulders up for 5 seconds, then drop and release. Repeat three times.

title: Soften Your Jaw
description: Unclench your jaw, lower your tongue, and let your face relax.

title: Progressive Muscle Relax
description: Tense each muscle group for 5 seconds, then release, moving down your body.

title: Rest Your Eyes
description: Close your eyes and let them rest for two full minutes.

title: Do Nothing for Three Minutes
description: Set a timer for three minutes and simply sit without a task.

title: Loosen Your Hands
description: Shake out both hands loosely for thirty seconds and notice how it feels.

title: Write One Thing That Went Well
description: Write down one small thing that went well today.

title: Say Thanks for Three Small Things
description: Mentally thank three small things: hot water, daylight, a good chair.

title: Text a Simple Thank You
description: Send a short thank-you message to someone who helped you recently.

title: Recall a Kind Memory
description: Remember one kind moment from the past week and replay it in detail.

title: List What You Have Today
description: List three things you have right now that you sometimes take for granted.

title: Thank Someone Out Loud
description: Tell someone face to face one specific thing you appreciate about them.

title: Soothe Yourself with Kind Words
description: Say to yourself: 'This is hard, and I'm doing my best.'

title: Wrap Yourself in a Blanket
description: Wrap a blanket around yourself for a few minutes and breathe slowly.

title: Make a Warm Drink
description: Make a warm drink and hold the cup with both hands, sipping slowly.

title: Play Something Gentle
description: Play one gentle song you like and give it your full attention.

title: Stretch Your Neck Gently
description: Slowly tilt your head side to side, staying soft and easy.

title: Pick One Task for Today
description: Choose exactly one task that matters and write it down.

title: Write a Five-Item To-Do List
description: Write down five tasks, then circle the single most important one.

title: Plan Your Top Three
description: Write the three most important things to do today, in order.

title: Set One Time Block
description: Reserve one 25-minute block for your most important task.

title: Write Tomorrow's Plan Tonight
description: Tonight, write the first task you'll start with tomorrow.

title: Decide the Next Step Only
description: For your biggest task, write down only the very next physical step.

title: Break a Task into Three Pieces
description: Take one task you're avoiding and split it into three small pieces.

title: Start With Two Minutes
description: Spend just two minutes starting the task you're avoiding.

title: Do One Micro-Task
description: Complete the smallest useful piece of your big project.

title: Estimate How Long It Really Takes
description: Guess how long your task takes, then check how close you were.

title: Clear Your Desk of One Thing
description: Put away one thing that is cluttering your workspace.

title: Close Ten Extra Tabs
description: Close the ten browser tabs you no longer need.

title: Sort Your Inbox Once
description: Open your inbox and decide the fate of ten messages: reply, file, or delete.

title: Silence Non-Essential Notifications
description: Turn off notifications for apps you don't need for the next hour.

title: Make Your Bed
description: Make your bed before anything else today.

title: Write Your Today Theme
description: Give today a one-word theme, like 'calm' or 'steady'.

title: Focus for Ten Minutes
description: Focus on one thing for ten uninterrupted minutes.

title: Use the One-Tab Rule
description: Work on one tab, one window, one task for 20 minutes.

title: Turn Off Your Phone
description: Switch your phone to airplane mode for 30 minutes and do one thing.

title: Try the Pomodoro First Round
description: Set a 25-minute timer, work on one task, then take a 5-minute break.

title: Move Your Phone to Another Room
description: Leave your phone in another room for the next 30 minutes.

title: Write One Paragraph
description: Write one paragraph toward the thing you keep postponing.

title: Review Your Notes for Five Minutes
description: Read through today's or yesterday's notes for five minutes.

title: Summarise One Page in One Sentence
description: Summarise one page of notes into a single sentence.

title: Quiz Yourself on Three Facts
description: Cover your notes and recall three key facts from memory.

title: Teach One Idea Aloud
description: Explain one concept out loud as if teaching a friend.

title: Re-read One Section Slowly
description: Re-read one section of your material and highlight three key points.

title: Write Three Revision Questions
description: Write three questions your teacher might ask on the exam.

title: Make a One-Week Revision Plan
description: Sketch which subjects you'll revise on each of the next seven days.

title: List What the Exam Covers
description: Write down every topic the exam covers, then mark your weakest two.

title: Pick Your Weakest Topic
description: Choose your single weakest topic and open its notes.

title: Start With the Easy Marks
description: Identify which exam sections earn marks for basic recall and plan to secure them first.

title: Plan Your Exam Morning
description: Write down what you'll do the morning of the exam, step by step.

title: Use Flashcards for Three Terms
description: Make flashcards for three terms you keep forgetting.

title: Remember a List With a Story
description: Turn a list you need to memorise into a short, silly story.

title: Test Yourself, Then Check
description: Recall five things from memory, then check your notes for accuracy.

title: Space Your Revision
description: Revise one topic today, and schedule the same topic again in two days.

title: Draw a Simple Diagram
description: Turn one concept into a simple diagram from memory.

title: Rewrite Notes in Your Own Words
description: Rewrite one page of notes using your own words only.

title: Add One Question to Your Notes
description: Write one question in the margin of your notes that you can't answer yet.

title: Use the Cornell Layout
description: Split a page into notes and keywords, and fill one section.

title: Highlight Only Three Lines
description: Take a dense page and highlight only the three most important lines.

title: Write One Question Per Section
description: For each section of your notes, write one question the section answers.

title: Message One Friend
description: Send one short message to a friend just to say hi.

title: Reply to a Stale Message
description: Reply to one message you've been meaning to answer.

title: Ask Someone How They Are
description: Text someone and ask how they're actually doing.

title: Send One Voice Note
description: Send a quick voice note to a friend instead of a text.

title: Call Someone for Ten Minutes
description: Call a friend or family member and talk for ten minutes.

title: Ask a Friend for Help
description: Ask one person for help with something specific today.

title: Tell Someone What You Need
description: Tell one person, clearly, what you need right now.

title: Share How You're Feeling
description: Tell one trusted person honestly how you're feeling today.

title: Ask for a Second Opinion
description: Run a small decision by someone you trust.

title: Thank a Friend Specifically
description: Tell a friend one specific thing they did that helped you.

title: Leave a Compliment
description: Give one sincere compliment to someone today.

title: Send a Message of Encouragement
description: Send one encouraging message to someone who is struggling.

title: Celebrate Someone's Win
description: Congratulate someone on a recent win, big or small.

title: Make a Small Offer of Help
description: Offer help to someone for one small thing today.

title: Invite Someone to Do Something Small
description: Invite a friend to a walk, a coffee, or a short call.

title: Check on Someone Quiet
description: Message someone you haven't heard from in a while, no agenda.

title: Introduce Two People
description: Introduce two people who could help each other.

title: Say Good Morning to a Neighbour
description: Greet someone in your building or street warmly.

title: Reconnect With an Old Friend
description: Send one message to an old friend you've lost touch with.

title: Listen Fully to Someone
description: Give someone your full attention for ten minutes without interrupting.

title: Stretch Your Back Slowly
description: Stand up and stretch your back gently for two minutes.

title: Touch Your Toes Five Times
description: Reach for your toes, hold five seconds, and come up slowly. Repeat five times.

title: Roll Your Shoulders
description: Roll your shoulders backward ten times, then forward ten times.

title: Do a Doorway Stretch
description: Place your hands on a doorframe and lean through to open your chest.

title: Stretch Your Neck Slowly
description: Gently move your head side to side and chin to chest for a minute.

title: Do a Full-Body Unwind
description: Stretch your neck, shoulders, back, legs, and wrists for five minutes.

title: Walk for Ten Minutes
description: Take a short ten-minute walk outside.

title: Walk and Notice the Weather
description: Take a five-minute walk and notice the temperature and light.

title: Take the Stairs
description: Use the stairs instead of the lift once today.

title: Walk to a New Spot
description: Walk somewhere you've never walked before, even just around the block.

title: Walk One Errand on Foot
description: Do one nearby errand on foot instead of by car or bus.

title: March in Place for a Minute
description: March in place, lifting knees, for one minute to get your blood moving.

title: Do Ten Squats
description: Do ten slow, controlled squats at your own pace.

title: Dance to One Song
description: Dance freely to one full song, alone if that feels right.

title: Do Five Push-Ups
description: Do five push-ups, on your knees if needed.

title: Move Your Body for Two Minutes
description: Jump, stretch, wiggle, or walk for two continuous minutes.

title: Lift Something Light Ten Times
description: Pick a light weight (or a bottle of water) and lift it ten times each side.

title: Drink a Full Glass of Water
description: Drink a full glass of water slowly, right now.

title: Refill Your Water Bottle
description: Fill your water bottle and set it where you'll see it.

title: Drink Water Before Each Meal
description: Drink a glass of water before each meal today.

title: Swap One Drink for Water
description: Swap your next sugary or caffeinated drink for water.

title: Close Your Eyes for Five Minutes
description: Lie down, close your eyes, and rest fully for five minutes.

title: Rest Your Eyes From Screens
description: Look away from every screen for three minutes.

title: Take a Ten-Minute Power Nap
description: Nap for no more than ten minutes, then get up and move.

title: Go to Bed a Little Earlier
description: Go to bed twenty minutes earlier than usual tonight.

title: Do Nothing Active for One Hour
description: Give yourself one screen-free hour of true rest this evening.

title: Write Three Lines About Today
description: Write three honest lines about how today has been.

title: Write a Free Page
description: Write freely for five minutes without stopping or judging.

title: Write One Worry and One Hope
description: Write down one worry and one hope for this week.

title: Write a Letter You Won't Send
description: Write a letter to someone about how you feel. You don't have to send it.

title: Write About a Happy Moment
description: Describe one happy moment from this week in as much detail as you can.

title: Keep a One-Question Journal
description: Answer: 'What would make today a little better?'

title: Name Your Feeling Precisely
description: Write the exact word for what you feel right now, beyond 'fine'.

title: Rate Your Feelings
description: Rate how you feel from 1 to 10, then write why it isn't lower.

title: Ask Where It Comes From
description: Pick one strong feeling and write what might be triggering it.

title: Notice the Feeling in Your Body
description: Write where you feel your current emotion in your body, without judging it.

title: Name Three Feelings You Had Today
description: List three different feelings you experienced today.

title: List What You Can Control
description: Write three things you can control today and one you can't.

title: Sort Worries Into Two Piles
description: Write your worries in two lists: changeable and not changeable today.

title: Pick One Controllable Action
description: Choose one small action within your control and commit to it today.

title: Write Your Boundary
description: Write one boundary you want to set or hold this week.

title: Decide What to Let Go Of
description: Write one thing you will stop trying to control this week.

title: Write Tomorrow's First Step
description: Write the first step you'll take tomorrow, and when.

title: Write One Good Thing About Today
description: Write one thing you want to remember about today.

title: Plan One Energising Thing
description: Plan one small thing you enjoy into tomorrow.

title: Set Tomorrow's Intention
description: Write one intention for how you want tomorrow to feel.

title: Preview Tomorrow's Schedule
description: Write tomorrow's schedule in three lines: morning, midday, evening.

title: List Three Wins From This Week
description: Write three things you finished or handled this week.

title: Write What You Learned
description: Write one lesson you learned from a recent mistake.

title: Note How Far You've Come
description: Compare where you were a month ago to where you are now.

title: Give Yourself Credit
description: Write one thing you did today that took courage or care.

title: Write Your Top Five Strengths
description: Write down five strengths you know you have.
